title: A piecewise quadratic scalar flattening has sharp quartic remainder constant eight

statement.quantifiers: Every finite weighted Hilbert H=l2(w), cube Q=[0,1]^N, corner e and points u,uprime; psi(s)=2s^2 for s<=1/2 and 1-2(1-s)^2 otherwise.
statement.assertion: ||psi(uprime)-psi(u)||_l1(w)^2<=8[||uprime-e||H^4-||u-e||H^4-4||u-e||H^2<u-e,uprime-u>]; 8 is optimal among coordinatewise C1 endpoint-fixing scalar functions.
assumptions: Cube coordinate signs relative to a fixed corner; nonnegative weights.
Sharpness uses arbitrary finite weights/dimensions and scalar C1 endpoint fixing.
Stationary chain extension needs its own exact cut lift and bounded stopping martingale.

inputs: Weighted cuts/cube embedding, quartic potential and corner fixed at time zero.
outputs: Sharp local inequality; stationary geometric-resolvent smoothing with global nonsharp constant224.
interface.precision: Exact elementary algebra and stopped martingale limit; source diagnostics not supplied.
costs: General finite cut representation can involve 2^n-2 subsets; rational finite coordinates permit the separate sorted-level polynomial compiler.
Sharp8 does not establish sharp224 or any infinite-coordinate finite algorithm.

proof_mechanism: Use |psiprime(s)|<=4|s-e| and coordinate signs to bound each difference by 2|delta||a+b|.
Balanced two-dimensional perturbations imply |etaprime(s)|<=sqrt(2C)min(s,1-s); integrating forces C>=8.
Quartic martingale telescoping eliminates derivative terms.
Stationarity evaluates accumulated stop and move weights as 1 and t; geometric horizon comparison needs no time reversal.
obstructions: No reversibility or independent increments required; replacing stationarity by an arbitrary initial law needs a new argument.
One-bank Poincare consequence is not a two-bank absolute spectral inequality.

potential_uses.target: Nonlinear smoothing on directed stationary processes
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Find a corner-aware potential inequality and exact lift, then account for stop/move occupation weights and input/output costs.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete written arguments and scoped finite checks; independent audit receipts or executable replay packages not supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
